errors.evidence: This part of the description introduces context about "VisuoThink" from the paper's caption, which is external information not present in the visual elements of the chart itself.
The word "significantly" is a subjective interpretation of the magnitude of the difference between the bars, rather than a direct, objective observation from the chart.
The bar for Claude-3.5-Sonnet under weak supervision is visibly higher than 3%; it is closer to 4%. The reference description also estimates it as 'close to 4%'.
